column1: # capture/format.tsv — TradingView export format, measured 2026-10-17 (impl-06 §4.7.3) by probe-00
# tv_build web:Claude-2.37337.1/Chrome-152.0.7977.130;pine:2026-09. Chart: "Download chart data", Time format UNIX timestamp.
# na, +inf, -inf and also |x| = 1e300 all print as an empty cell; 1e-300 prints 1e-300; values print shortest round-trip.
# Chart CSV: no BOM, no volume column, no final newline. Trades CSV: UTF-8 BOM, exit row before entry row,
# times "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" (bar open of the fill bar, UTC, no Z); the open trade prints Open / Open / — on its exit row.
# trades_time_format (pin:06-trades-time-format) records that spelling: ymd_hm = YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, UTC; time_format stays the chart's.
# The Metrics view has no export in the Premium UI: sum_* keys are not measured (O6).
